changes.title: Detect damaged statistics caches
changes.text: A bit flip in a temporary row cache now triggers a rebuild instead of silently changing recorded statistics.

changes.title: Compatible row-cache refresh
changes.text: Older row caches rebuild once from original run logs, then remain available for normal fast reloads.

changes.title: Checksum without extra buffer copy
changes.text: Cache writing computes its integrity check directly from the existing buffer, preserving raw-history formats and avoiding another full-size copy.

changes.title: Cache corruption and migration coverage
changes.text: Added tests for bit flips, valid-text damage, older cache migration and unchanged genuine history; existing allocation checks still exercise malformed payloads.

changes.title: Verified audit and build records
changes.text: Recorded the preceding Sort fix's Android evidence, cache corruption reproductions and remaining audit limitations.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I added an integrity check to temporary row caches because valid-looking text could still be damaged. Original run logs stay untouched, and older caches rebuild safely.
